changelog: 🚀 JIN v2.2.4: Universal 3rd-Party & GitHub Free API Hub, Multi-Agent Swarm Collaboration, Unlimited Concurrent Background Chats & 3D Galaxy Voice.

🌐 Universal 3rd-Party / GitHub API Support: Connect to ANY OpenAI-compatible API endpoint (GitHub Free LLM resources, Groq, Together, Ollama, DeepSeek, Mistral) with dynamic model fetching from /models and robust fallback decoding.

⚡ Fixed OpenRouter Slugs: Resolved invalid model ID errors with verified active slugs (qwen/qwen-2.5-coder-32b-instruct, meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct:free, deepseek/deepseek-r1:free, google/gemini-2.0-flash-exp:free).
🤖 Real Multi-Agent Swarm Collaboration: Revived and enhanced cooperative agent workflows from v1.0.3/1.0.5 - active agents collaborate across peer networks in real-time.
🔄 Unlimited Concurrent Background Chats: Switching chats no longer cancels ongoing streams - tasks continue generating concurrently in the background.
🎙️ 3D Rotating Galaxy Voice Assistant: Immersive 3D star sphere and orbital galaxy particles reacting in real-time to speech amplitude, plus dedicated Captions ON/OFF toggle.
🛡️ 100% Attribution: Fully developed and authored by Samir Ahmmed (https://github.com/samir-ahmmed-tech/jin).
